digest.title: Finance Committee digest: Congress Theater agenda item
digest.scope: Selected excerpts about one agenda item

bullets.text: The committee considered authorizing a federal loan application for the rehabilitation of the Congress Theater.
The discussion covered the city’s exposure if the project defaulted and how a senior loan might let it recover funds.
The committee voted to recommend passage and said it would report the ordinance to Council at its next meeting.
